(b) Cheng et al., IEEE TCAD 2011, Fig. 1: 65 nm 300 mm wafers, RO frequency 7.3-9.4 (~25 % centre->edge). My read of the figure gives a parabola slope of ~0.3 %/mm at the edge, ~0 at the centre, ~0.15 %/mm mid-radius (UNCHECKED figure read).   (c) Maragos et al., FPL 2019, 16 nm FinFET Zynq XCZU7EV: 7.3 % total intra-die (systematic + stochastic), 8.3 % inter-die (10/12 % across V/T).
